header.title: Versioned provider components
header.description: Packages are checked for signature, manifest, component format and permitted imports before the atomic installation. Unsigned packages only work when the service runs in explicit development mode.

install.label: .rdplug package
install.hint: Maximum 65 MiB; binary data is not stored as a temporary upload.

installed.title: Local inventory
installed.empty: No external plugin versions installed yet. The native v1 resolvers remain available.

card.author: by {author}
card.concurrency_hint: At most {count} downloads run through this plugin at the same time
card.superseded_hint: A newer version of this plugin is installed and is loaded instead. It stays on disk while unfinished work is still bound to it, and can be removed otherwise.
card.active_version_hint: This is the version being loaded.
card.withdrawn_hint: This build is refused from the next start on; the signing key is untouched.

keys.title: Confirmed publishers
keys.description: Plugins from third parties are signed with their author’s own key. A key you confirm here stays trusted until you revoke it; revoking one disables its plugins from the next restart.
keys.empty: No third-party signing keys confirmed. Only plugins signed with the release key are accepted.

trust.title: Confirm the publisher
trust.intro: {name} {version} is signed with a key this installation has not seen before.
trust.warning: Only confirm if this fingerprint matches the one published by the plugin’s author. A wrong key lets someone else ship updates for this plugin.

incompatible.title: Installed but not runnable
incompatible.description: These packages are on disk but this version cannot run them. They are left alone until you remove them — deleting them automatically would only make a hoster disappear without explanation. A package that needs a newer build works again once its author rebuilds it.

reason.plugin.manifest_outdated: Built for an older plugin contract. The author has to rebuild it for this version.
reason.plugin.capability_unknown: Asks for a permission or plugin type this version does not know.
reason.plugin.manifest_unreadable: The manifest cannot be read at all; the package is damaged.

remove.title: Delete plugin?
remove.description: “{name}” is removed from disk. Getting it back means installing it again.
remove.superseded_description: Version {version} of “{name}” is removed from disk. Version {active} stays installed and keeps being loaded.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this build?
withdraw.intro: “{name}” {version} is refused by its exact package content, not by its version number.
withdraw.restart: It keeps running until the service restarts; from the next start it is skipped.
withdraw.key_untouched: The signing key stays trusted. Every other plugin signed with it, and every other version of this one, keeps loading.
withdraw.reason_hint: Kept as written and shown beside the entry.

withdrawn.title: Packages this machine refuses
withdrawn.description: A withdrawal takes effect at the next start: a package already loaded keeps running until then and is skipped from then on. Only this one build is affected — the signing key stays trusted, and every other plugin signed with it keeps loading.
withdrawn.empty: No package is withdrawn. Every installed version that verifies is loaded.
withdrawn.not_installed: This package is not installed here; its digest is all that identifies it.
